verdict.rationale: Token2 ships desktop, mobile and browser tools, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The only privacy-related item says TOTP computation happens locally and no seed is sent to a server, which is an adjacent data-handling claim, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
